text: Addendum No. 1 dated August 10, 2026: from September 20, 2026, the unit price of External SSD 1TB is changed to IDR 1,814,400.00 per unit.
Unit prices are set out in Schedule A and remain fixed for the term of this Agreement.
A change to a unit price takes effect only through a written addendum signed by both parties, and never retroactively.
Each invoice carries VAT at 11% of the subtotal, which is the tax base.
